blocks.text: Today's tag is $49.39, and that is what will be billed.
The card step will not raise it.
Extra bulb is available for thirteen dollars and thirty nine cents and is not ticked.
Ordinary carrier cost is already inside today's tag. No packing line is added.
Fragile glass leaves the stockroom in a double mailer.
Last week's tag on Cotton paper envelopes, 20 was fifty eight dollars and eleven cents.
